subject: Evidence lifecycle & credential rotation sync
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@finserve.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding details + credential rotation cadence

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for agreeing to help us onboard Redwood to our vendor security portal. We ran your SIG/CAIQ report and have a couple of process items we need to lock down before we start pulling evidence into our system:

- Who will own the portal credentials (API token vs. SSO service account)?
- Expected cadence for evidence rotation for SOC 2 artifacts (quarterly, semi-annual)?
- Where will you host exportable evidence (S3 path or shared Drive) and do you support pre-signed URLs for short-lived access?
- Can you provide a field mapping between your internal artifact names and SIG/CAIQ question IDs so we can auto-map?

I attached our initial RFI (FinServe_Security_RFI_v1.docx) with a few highlighted items we want to accelerate. Could we do a 30‑minute sync this week to confirm owners and share a runbook?

Best,
Emma Torres
Security Risk Analyst
FinServe Inc.
emma@finserve.com
(415) 555-0182
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Torres <emma@finserve.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding details + credential rotation cadence

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the RFI.

Short answers up front:
- Portal ownership: Redwood prefers an SSO-based service account for provisioning and an API token for automated pulls. We can support either; for FinServe I'd recommend SSO + a scoped service account (reduces token sprawl).
- Rotation cadence: we propose quarterly evidence rotation for SOC 2 artifacts and monthly checks for CAIQ/SIG mappings where questions change.
- Evidence host: we can publish exports to an S3 bucket and provide time-limited pre-signed URLs for ingestion.

I attached our maintenance runbook (redwood_portal_maintenance_runbook_v1.pdf) that outlines the steps and owners. Please review before the call.

Can you do Thu 05/27 at 10:00am PT for a 30‑minute sync? If that works I’ll put together a mutual action plan and add it to the Google doc linked below.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, GTM Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Torres <emma@finserve.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding details + credential rotation cadence

Emma / team —

Adding a few technical details that will help with the mapping and access work:

- SSO/Service account: we recommend creating a SAML/SCIM service account named "redwood-vendr-sync@redwood.ai" with attribute "role=vendor_sync". That account will be used for interactive provisioning.
- API: token-scoped access is supported for read-only artifact pulls (scope: artifacts.read). If you prefer token-based, we’ll rotate tokens every 90 days and will publish rotation events to the webhook endpoint you provide.
- Evidence storage: primary export location will be s3://redwood-evidence/finserve/runbook-2027-05. Files are written with timestamped prefixes. We will produce a manifest JSON on each export.

Attached is a preliminary SIG/CAIQ field mapping that maps our artifact names to your question IDs (sig_caiq_field_map.csv). It’s not final, but should accelerate auto-mapping on your side.

@Priyom — can you confirm the webhook payload schema and whether we should include MD5 checksums in the manifest?

—Monica
Senior Security Automation Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Torres <emma@finserve.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, Jared Li <jared.li@finserve.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding details + credential rotation cadence

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying items before the call:

- Can you confirm retention policy for access logs and whether you can provide exported logs for a 12-month range (FinServe needs this for audit purposes).
- DocuSign: we have an access authorization form our security team requires for service account creation. I uploaded it here: https://app.docusign.com/AccessForm/abc-987. Please sign and return so our IT team can provision the SAML entry.
- Mapping file: the CSV looks good; we’ll attempt an auto-import and will flag mismatches in the import report.

If all good we’ll go ahead and provision the SAML entry after we receive the signed access form. Looking forward to the Thu call.

Best,
Emma
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Torres <emma@finserve.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00

Emma —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming actions and owners before the Thu 10:00am PT call:

1) Stephanie: create mutual action plan in the shared Google doc and own timeline. (Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/MA-Plan-12345)
2) Monica: finalize the SIG/CAIQ mapping and add MD5 checksums to the next manifest. Deliverable due 2027-05-28 EOD.
3) Priyom: publish webhook payload schema and confirm manifest fields (include md5, size_bytes, last_modified). Deliverable due 2027-05-27 noon PT.
4) FinServe (Emma/Jared): sign DocuSign access form and provision SAML entry for redwood-vendr-sync. We’ll need the SAML entity ID and ACS URL so we can verify attributes.

Retention: Redwood retains access logs for 13 months and can provide exported CSVs scoped to a 12-month window for audits. We will include a sample export in the next manifest.

Attachments to link in the meeting invite: redwood_portal_maintenance_runbook_v1.pdf, sig_caiq_field_map.csv, access-request-docusign.pdf

See you Thu.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
